female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

work-effort-faster-general.title: Pitches that emphasize current employment or personal work effort predict faster funding regardless of gender.
work-effort-faster-general.body: Borrowers who describe their active work ethic or current employment status tend to fund faster, regardless of gender.

female-business-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state a business challenge, such as slow sales, may fund faster.

female-large-scale-expansion-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention expanding their business to a large scale in the future may fund faster.

female-smallholder-location-faster.body: Female borrowers who identify as a smallholder farmer from a specific location may fund faster.

female-external-family-location-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention external family locations may fund more slowly.

female-professional-role-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific professional roles like seamstress or laborer may fund faster.

female-inventory-list-faster.body: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items to be purchased may fund faster.

female-photo-note-faster.body: Female borrowers who include a specific note about the loan photo may fund faster.

female-children-mentions-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention children may fund faster.

female-older-age-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention being aged 50 or older may fund faster.

female-indonesia-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention being from Indonesia may fund faster.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
female-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency mentions appeared in faster pitches.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include direct expressions of gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that gratitude appeared in faster pitches.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific expressions of gratitude to lenders may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new professional role observation.

female-income-unpredictability-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention that farming income can be unpredictable may fund more slowly.
female-income-unpredictability-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-spouse-income-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention using a spouse's income for loan repayment may fund faster.
female-spouse-income-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation regarding borrower age.

female-children-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about their children fund faster.
female-children-details-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for gender-general work effort claim.

female-hardworking-slower.title: Female borrowers who use the word 'hardworking' to describe themselves may fund more slowly.
female-hardworking-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observations that personal effort/work ethic predicts faster funding.

male-precariousness-slower.title: Male borrowers who mention future employment goals or income precariousness may fund more slowly.
male-precariousness-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for female-children-mentions-faster puzzle.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that borrowers aged 50+ fund faster.

female-brac-explanation-faster.title: Female borrowers who include a standardized explanation of the BRAC microfinance program may fund faster.
female-brac-explanation-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain memory cap.
